nodes.label: ΛCDM 5 / 27 / 68 mapped to populated vs unpopulated field states
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: The 95% invisible sector is read not as a missing variable but as the field background against which the 5% visible matter moves: dark matter supplies boundary conditions, dark energy the outward potential buffer.

nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md

nodes.label: The 2 : 10 : 24 corridor partition
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: 2 cells for the photon's two polarisations, 10 for the independent components of a symmetric 4D metric tensor, 24 for the unallocated null vacuum sub-block — an integer geometric mirror of 5.56 / 27.78 / 66.67 %.

nodes.label: The 3D atomic index (n, l, k) degeneracy sphere
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md

nodes.label: The 14D Berry connection and corridor Berry phase
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: Gauge invariance is obtained via cyclic corridor loops, giving topological quantization and correlation stability; evaluated explicitly for ground-state helium.

nodes.label: Löwdin correlation energy over the corridor RDM cumulant
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: Dynamic correlation is assigned to the 10 metric core cells and evaluated across the 2 : 10 : 24 partition, so the corridor partition does work in a closed-form energy expression rather than only in an analogy.

nodes.label: Topological prohibition of forbidden transitions (Δl = ±1)
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: Setting the first Chern number to 1 and photon helicity ±1 makes Δl = 0 and |Δl| > 1 fail global topological gauge invariance during radiative decay, recovering the electric-dipole selection rule from the corridor's chiral boundary.

nodes.label: Composite-fermion gaps, thickness softening and LL mixing
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: The 24-cell vacuum reservoir fraction α = 2/3 sets the softening attenuation factor S(w), which is then compared against experimental GaAs activation gaps at w/l_B = 0.5–2.0.

nodes.label: The Moore–Read Pfaffian state at ν = 5/2
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: Derived as the exact zero-energy eigenstate of the Greiter–Wen–Wilczek three-body Hamiltonian, since standard Jastrow factors fail at half filling when three particles cluster.

nodes.label: Ising anyons: fusion algebra, F/R matrices and braiding
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: σ × σ = 1 + ψ gives d_σ = √2 and Hilbert-space scaling (√2)^N; F is fixed by the pentagon equation and R by the hexagon, so braiding alone is non-universal and needs magic-state distillation or topology-changing operations.

nodes.label: Edge reconstruction, KFP flow and upstream neutral modes
nodes.source_file: drive/The Method Materials/Everything we can see, touch, or detect using elec....md
nodes.rationale: Charge modes take long-range Coulomb renormalisation and neutral modes do not, which is why v_n is set by short-range scales and controls interferometric dephasing.
